expert.name: Tenzin
expert.quote: Three Himalayan worlds in one overland run: Bhutan, then Sikkim, then the old tea hills of Darjeeling.
expert.tip: Sikkim needs its own inner line permit on top of the Bhutan paperwork. Send us your passport scans a month ahead and we handle both.

summary: 11 days through Phuentsholing, Thimphu, Paro, Gangtok, Darjeeling, with 10 nights, daily breakfast and a licensed Bhutanese guide: the thimphu sightseeing tour, the ta dzong and rinpung dzong, the hike to the tiger's nest, the gangtok sightseeing tour.
included: Included: 10 nights across Phuentsholing, Thimphu, Paro, Gangtok, Darjeeling with daily breakfast; all land transfers by private vehicle; the Thimphu sightseeing tour; the Ta Dzong and Rinpung Dzong; the Hike to the Tiger's Nest; the Gangtok sightseeing tour; the Darjeeling sightseeing tour; a licensed Bhutanese guide; permits and the sustainable development fee as quoted.
not_included: Not included: international and domestic flights; lunches and any meals not listed; monument entrance fees where not stated; travel insurance; personal expenses.
